title: Family Picnic with Mother & Baby, 1940s B&W Outdoor Snapshot Photo
description: A candid vintage black-and-white photograph taken on July 31, 1949, capturing a family picnic near a lake. A woman reclines on a dark blanket in the foreground while a baby sits safely inside a wooden playpen set up on the grass. In the background, a picnic table is laden with food supplies and thermoses beneath tall trees, offering a glimpse into post-WWII middle-class American family recreation.
